q: A non-renewable resource is a natural substance that is not replenished with the speed at which it is _____.
e: A non-renewable resource is a natural substance that is not replenished with the speed at which it is consumed. A non-renewable source is not replenished as fast as we use it. discovered or exported is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Renewable energy sources are also called _____ energy sources.
e: Renewable energy sources are also called non-conventional energy sources. Renewable, or non-conventional, sources are replenished by natural processes on a human time scale. unconventional or secondary is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Non-renewable energy resources include coal, natural gas, crude oil, and _____.
e: Non-renewable energy resources include coal, natural gas, crude oil, and nuclear energy. Nuclear fission consumes uranium fuel, so that source is classed as non-renewable. geothermal energy or biomass is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Renewable resources are replenished naturally and over short periods of time, so are in a virtually _____ supply.
e: Renewable resources are replenished naturally and over short periods of time, so are in a virtually unlimited supply. Renewable, or non-conventional, sources are replenished by natural processes on a human time scale. limited or exhaustible is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: They cannot be exhausted easily and can be generated at a constant rate for their use _____.
e: They cannot be exhausted easily and can be generated at a constant rate for their use over and over again. A renewable source can be used again and again because nature replenishes it. only once or in limited cycles is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: In our daily life we use different forms of energy. The most common forms of energy are heat, light and _____.
e: In our daily life we use different forms of energy. The most common forms of energy are heat, light and electricity. sound or chemical is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Non-renewable resources occur in limited and exhaustible quantities and cannot be regenerated in a _____ period of time.
e: Non-renewable resources occur in limited and exhaustible quantities and cannot be regenerated in a short period of time. A non-renewable source is not replenished as fast as we use it. long or geological is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Renewable energy sources are continuously replenished by _____ processes.
e: Renewable energy sources are continuously replenished by mechanical processes. Renewable, or non-conventional, sources are replenished by natural processes on a human time scale. artificial or natural is a different idea, so those options are wrong.
